id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_040.pack|cs_: "Ladies and gentlemen! The hot season has come again this year! Are you ready?! It's time to fight!
"What great matches will be born this year at Octagonia Arena, the holy ground of battle?! The Masked Tourney begins!
"And now, the moment you've all been waiting for! Who will be your partner? What a thrill! Let's hold the grand drawing!
"I'll pull two balls from this box and read out the numbers! Those two called will become partners!
"The Masked Tourney is a 2-on-2 tag match! Join forces with your chosen partner and win the championship!
"Here we go!
"Number 11! Oh, the first one chosen is a first-time entrant, number 11! Come on up to the stage, number 11!
"Who could it be? Who will number 11's partner be?!
"Number 8! Number 8 has been chosen!
"Number 8, please come up to the stage!
"Pleased to meet you.
"Hold it right there!!
"I can't leave the princess's partner to someone of unknown origin. I demand this drawing be called off.
"B-but even if you say that, these are the rules...
"What?!
"I'll go ask right away!
"A-as a special invitation, contestant number 8 is this old gentleman's partner! Number 11 will be redrawn!
"Hey! What's the meaning of this!
"That's dirty! Play fair!
"P-please be quiet! This is final, and it won't be overturned!
"S-so then, we'll redraw number 11's partner!
"Number 7! Number 7, please come up to the stage!
"Well, looks like that's me.
"Vince...?
"W-what's this?! Last tournament's champion, Vince, has become number 11's partner!
"Hey there. Let's do our best together.
The drawing went on. Some rejoiced and some groaned at the numbers read, and it ended with the venue buzzing.
"That concludes the drawing! Contestants, work with your partners and aim for the championship!
